sources.name: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)
sources.note: FRED hosts series produced by several agencies (BLS, BEA, Census). Each series records its own originating agency where FRED supplies it.
sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.update_frequency: Daily pipeline run; individual series update on their own publication schedules.

sources.name: American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
sources.note: 5-year rolling estimates. Dollar values are expressed in the vintage's inflation-adjusted dollars and are not comparable across vintages.
sources.update_frequency: Annual vintage; checked weekly by the pipeline.

sources.name: County Business Patterns
sources.note: Establishment and employment counts. Disclosure-suppressed cells are shown as 'Not disclosed' and excluded from rankings and change calculations.

sources.name: Building Permits Survey (BPS)
sources.note: County-level new-private-housing-units-authorized-by-permit, merged into each county record as building_permits. Not every county has ever reported to BPS, so coverage is expected to be partial rather than universal.
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, hosted on FRED per county
sources.update_frequency: Annual; refreshed independently of the rest of this pipeline (see permits_last_successful_update) because of its per-county request volume.

sources.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW)
sources.note: County-level average weekly wage across all industries and ownership sectors, merged into each county record as avg_weekly_wage. No API key required. A direct labor-cost figure for the local workforce, distinct from ACS's household-income metrics.
sources.update_frequency: Annual file, published with a 5-6 month lag; refreshed independently of the rest of this pipeline (see bls_last_successful_update).
